title: Cutters and Trimmers, Hand
description: Use hand tools or hand-held power tools to cut and trim a variety of manufactured items, such as carpet, fabric, stone, glass, or rubber.

tasks.text: Mark or discard items with defects such as spots, stains, scars, snags, chips, scratches, or unacceptable shapes or finishes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking workpieces is hands-on physical task

dwas.name: Mark products, workpieces, or equipment with identifying information.

tasks.text: Trim excess material or cut threads off finished products, such as cutting loose ends of plastic off a manufactured toy for a smoother finish.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

dwas.name: Trim excess material from workpieces.

tasks.text: Cut, shape, and trim materials, such as textiles, food, glass, stone, and metal, using knives, scissors, and other hand tools, portable power tools, or bench-mounted tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on industrial material cutting

dwas.name: Shape metal workpieces with hammers or other small hand tools.
Cut industrial materials in preparation for fabrication or processing.

tasks.text: Position templates or measure materials to locate specified points of cuts or to obtain maximum yields, using rules, scales, or patterns.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking reference points requires hands-on measurement

dwas.name: Measure materials to mark reference points, cutting lines, or other indicators.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Position patterns on equipment, materials, or workpieces.

tasks.text: Read work orders to determine dimensions, cutting locations, and quantities to cut.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.

tasks.text: Mark cutting lines around patterns or templates, or follow layout points, using squares, rules, and straightedges, and chalk, pencils, or scribes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drawing guide lines on materials is hands-on

dwas.name: Draw guide lines or markings on materials or workpieces using patterns or other references.

tasks.text: Mark identification numbers, trademarks, grades, marketing data, sizes, or model numbers on products.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking workpieces is hands-on physical task

dwas.name: Mark products, workpieces, or equipment with identifying information.

tasks.text: Unroll, lay out, attach, or mount materials or items on cutting tables or machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Separate materials or products according to size, weight, type, condition, color, or shade.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical product sorting needs manipulation in warehouse

dwas.name: Sort materials or products for processing, storing, shipping, or grading.

tasks.text: Fold or shape materials before or after cutting them.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Adjusting fabric is tactile manual work

dwas.name: Adjust fabrics or other materials during garment production.

tasks.text: Replace or sharpen dulled cutting tools such as saws.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal and fitting of worn components

dwas.name: Replace worn equipment components.
Sharpen cutting or grinding tools.

tasks.text: Lower table-mounted cutters such as knife blades, cutting wheels, or saws to cut items to specified sizes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cutting equipment operation is manual and judgment-based

dwas.name: Operate cutting equipment.

tasks.text: Stack cut items and load them on racks or conveyors or onto trucks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on stacking of finished items

dwas.name: Stack finished items for further processing or shipment.

tasks.text: Adjust guides and stops to control depths and widths of cuts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control setting for cutting

dwas.name: Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.

tasks.text: Count or weigh and bundle items.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Counting physical products needs presence or sensors

dwas.name: Count finished products or workpieces.
Weigh finished products.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Clean, treat, buff, or polish finished items, using grinders, brushes, chisels, and cleaning solutions and polishing materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Clean workpieces or finished products.
Polish materials, workpieces, or finished products.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Route items to provide cutouts for parts, using portable routers, grinders, and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Operate grinding equipment.
Operate cutting equipment.

tasks.text: Transport items to work or storage areas, using carts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical moving of products between work areas

dwas.name: Move products, materials, or equipment between work areas.
